game.title: XCOM: Enemy Unknown
game.blurb: Turn-based strategy game about defending Earth from an alien invasion, from Firaxis (RAWG also lists Feral Interactive and 2K), published by 2K Games and Feral Interactive, released 2012-10-09. RAWG average playtime: 13 hours. Genre: Strategy. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes, following the campaign, the base, the air war, multiplayer and the Enemy Within expansion.

chapters.title: The Campaign
chapters.summary: The tutorial mission, beating the game, and the story milestones hidden on Steam. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Classic, Impossible and Ironman
chapters.summary: Beating the game on Classic, Impossible and Ironman, from all five starting locations, with one soldier surviving everything, and other hard-difficulty feats.

chapters.title: Base, Research and the Council
chapters.summary: Building facilities, research, autopsies and Foundry projects, scientists and engineers, credits, satellites, Council requests, powered armour and the S.H.I.V.

chapters.title: The Air War
chapters.summary: Shooting down UFOs: the first, forty in all, and one of each alien craft.

chapters.title: Tactical Combat
chapters.summary: Alien kill counts, explosives, flying kills, mind control, squad feats, Colonel rank and terror mission ratings.

chapters.title: Multiplayer
chapters.summary: Winning a multiplayer match and playing someone who already has Bubonic.

chapters.title: Enemy Within: Augments, Gene Mods and Squads
chapters.summary: Augmenting and modifying soldiers, tactical subsystems, mixed squads, Muton Berserkers, elite enemies and other single-player feats.

chapters.title: Enemy Within: New Missions and Threats
chapters.summary: The newest global threat and its location, alien waves, the infestation, Deluge, Furies, the new special mission and base security.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 13910); RAWG lists four additions: "XCOM: Enemy Within", "XCOM: Enemy Unknown - Slingshot", "XCOM Enemy Unknown - Elite Edition" and "XCOM: Enemy Unknown Complete Pack". Steam app 200510 ("XCOM: Enemy Unknown" in the store list; its schema is named "ValveTestApp200510", a placeholder) was used; the store list has no separate Enemy Within app. ACHIEVEMENT_55 to 84 form one block whose descriptions mostly say "in single player" and mention augments, modifications and new threats, and one of them is itself named "Enemy Within", so the block was treated as the Enemy Within expansion, a reasoned guess; it is split into two chapters by theme, our own choice. "An Army Of Four" (no Squad Size upgrade, Classic or harder) sits in that block but was put with the difficulty runs. StrategyWiki has no page under "XCOM: Enemy Unknown" or "XCOM Enemy Unknown". xcom.fandom.com answers the API under "XCOM: Enemy Unknown" with about 45 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 15 of 85 Steam achievements are hidden (ACHIEVEMENT_16 to 22, 44, 45, 48 and 50 to 54); all sit in the campaign chapter as story milestones. "Rising Dragon" (9.1%) and "All Aboard" (11.2%) are much rarer than the rest and may belong to the Slingshot content, but the data does not say so. "The Volunteer" is hidden, and the later "Guardian of Earth" refers to designating a soldier as the Volunteer.
